references.title: A Meshfree Peridynamic Model for Brittle Fracture in Randomly Heterogeneous Materials
references.support: Spatial stochastic material properties and symmetric two-point formulations in heterogeneous LPS. The paper uses harmonic means for elastic parameters and a separate fracture-energy construction.
references.limit: Its brittle critical-stretch law is not the present endpoint-star variational softening law. We borrow spatial-field and symmetric-property principles, not its fracture criterion or convergence claims.

references.title: Structural analysis of ischemic stroke thrombi: histological indications for therapy resistance
references.support: Histology of retrieved stroke thrombi identifies interspersed RBC-rich and platelet/fibrin-rich structures with distinct local organization.
references.limit: Histological composition is not mapped to q, sc, or fracture toughness here. No measured patient material field is used.

references.title: Non contrast enhanced volumetric histology of blood clots through high resolution propagation-based X-ray microtomography
references.support: Three-dimensional volumetric clot imaging motivates examining internal spatial organization instead of only bulk composition.
references.limit: Imaging resolution and visible organization do not calibrate the 300 um Gaussian correlation length.

references.title: Quantification of clot spatial heterogeneity and its impact on thrombectomy
references.support: Spatial heterogeneity was quantified using analysis grids spanning 0.2–0.6 mm.
references.limit: Analysis grid size is not a measured Gaussian random-field correlation length. We do not infer that 0.3 mm is a physical correlation length.

references.title: Arterial shear rate determines the structure and mechanical properties of whole-blood clots
references.support: Local effective stiffness varies with composition; platelet/fibrin-rich regions were stiffer than RBC-rich regions in that study.
references.limit: This supports the existence of local mechanical variation but does not provide our softening thresholds. G and K are deliberately unchanged.

references.title: Adhesive and cohesive fracture of blood clots: Experiments and modeling
references.support: Distinguishes bulk cohesive and interface adhesive fracture. Reports rate-dependent fracture energies and differing RBC/platelet effects on bulk and interface fracture.
references.limit: Neither stiffness nor sc is calibrated Gc. The present kappa-based law has no explicit rate variable; inertia and drag do not reproduce measured intrinsic rate dependence.

references.title: Gaussian covariance model
references.support: GSTools Gaussian covariance has a rescale convention. This implementation explicitly sets rescale=1, so C_z(r)=exp(-(r/300um)^2).
references.limit: The bounded tanh transform and finite sample alter empirical q correlation. The nominal covariance applies to z.

calibration: All seed, alpha, sc field and nominal length choices are exploratory; no tissue-label assignment
prior_ten_percent: Previous 20261016T222934Z changed s0 by up to 10%, used a 250 um smoothed field and indentation, with no 20–200 targets. It is not a direct control for this sc-only shear experiment.
